set_name: Copperline Health Partners TI, Suite 300, Permit Set 2026-08-14

candidates.candidate: Remove existing gypsum board partitions shown dashed, full height to deck where shown, including studs, track, and in-wall items
candidates.quote: REMOVE EXISTING GYPSUM BOARD PARTITIONS INDICATED DASHED, INCLUDING STUDS, TRACK, AND IN-WALL ITEMS, FULL HEIGHT TO DECK WHERE SHOWN.
candidates.reason: Keyed note describes the removal itself. Selective demolition, 02 41 19.

candidates.candidate: Remove existing carpet and rubber base throughout Suite 300
candidates.quote: REMOVE EXISTING CARPET AND RUBBER BASE THROUGHOUT SUITE 300. PREPARE SLAB TO RECEIVE NEW FINISHES, SEE A-201.
candidates.reason: Keyed note describes the removal. Slab preparation is a separate candidate under Division 09 because A-201 defines it (cand-008).

candidates.candidate: Remove existing 2x4 acoustical ceiling tile and grid in Open Office 301 and Rooms 305 through 309; protect existing Corridor 300 ceiling to remain
candidates.quote: REMOVE EXISTING 2X4 ACOUSTICAL CEILING TILE AND GRID IN OPEN OFFICE 301 AND ROOMS 305 THROUGH 309. EXISTING CEILING IN CORRIDOR 300 TO REMAIN AND BE PROTECTED.
candidates.reason: Keyed note describes the removal and names the rooms.

candidates.candidate: Remove existing light fixtures in demolished ceiling areas and abandon circuits
candidates.quote: EXISTING LIGHT FIXTURES IN DEMOLISHED CEILING AREAS TO BE REMOVED BY ELECTRICAL CONTRACTOR. SEE E-101 FOR CIRCUITS TO BE ABANDONED.
candidates.reason: A-101 assigns the removal to the electrical contractor and points to E-101 for the circuits. E-101 extracted text contains device tags and circuit numbers only and no demolition note was found there, so the electrical demolition scope is not confirmed on an electrical sheet. Carried in Division 26 because the architectural sheet assigns it to the electrical trade.

candidates.candidate: Temporary dust partition at the suite entry from Corridor 300 for the duration of demolition; protect existing corridor carpet and wall covering
candidates.quote: PROVIDE TEMPORARY DUST PARTITION AT SUITE ENTRY FROM CORRIDOR 300 FOR THE DURATION OF DEMOLITION. PROTECT EXISTING CORRIDOR CARPET AND WALL COVERING.
candidates.reason: Temporary facilities and protection, 01 50 00.

candidates.candidate: Carpet tile CPT-1, 24x24 glue-down, quarter-turn, in Open Office 301 and Offices 305 through 309
candidates.quote: CPT-1 CARPET TILE, 24X24, GLUE-DOWN, OPEN OFFICE 301, OFFICES 305-309, INSTALL QUARTER-TURN
candidates.reason: Finish schedule row defines the product and rooms.

candidates.candidate: Luxury vinyl tile LVT-1, 6x36 plank, in Break Room 312
candidates.quote: LVT-1 LUXURY VINYL TILE, 6X36 PLANK, BREAK ROOM 312, SEE FINISH NOTE 2
candidates.reason: Finish schedule row defines the product and room.

candidates.candidate: Level existing slab in Break Room 312 with cementitious underlayment to 1/8 in in 10 ft before LVT-1
candidates.quote: LEVEL EXISTING SLAB IN BREAK ROOM 312 PRIOR TO LVT-1 INSTALLATION. FLATNESS 1/8 IN IN 10 FT. USE CEMENTITIOUS UNDERLAYMENT.
candidates.reason: Flooring preparation, 09 05 61. A-101 note 2 calls for slab prep generally; A-201 limits the leveling requirement to Break Room 312.
candidates.notes: Only Break Room 312 has a stated flatness requirement. Slab prep elsewhere is limited to what note 2 on A-101 calls for after carpet removal.

candidates.candidate: Plastic laminate base cabinets with adjustable shelves and 30 in high plastic laminate upper cabinets in Break Room 312
candidates.quote: PLASTIC LAMINATE BASE CABINETS WITH ADJUSTABLE SHELVES AND PLASTIC LAMINATE UPPER CABINETS, 30 IN HIGH.
candidates.reason: Detail describes the casework. Architectural wood casework, 06 41 00.

candidates.candidate: Continuous 2x wood blocking in wall at the upper cabinet hanging rail, Break Room 312
candidates.quote: PROVIDE CONTINUOUS 2X WOOD BLOCKING IN WALL AT UPPER CABINET HANGING RAIL.
candidates.reason: Detail note describes the blocking. Miscellaneous rough carpentry, 06 10 53, kept separate from the casework it supports.

candidates.candidate: Solid surface countertop, 1/2 in thick, with integral 4 in backsplash and sink cutout, Break Room 312
candidates.quote: SOLID SURFACE COUNTERTOP, 1/2 IN THICK, WITH INTEGRAL 4 IN BACKSPLASH. ... CUTOUT BY COUNTERTOP FABRICATOR.
candidates.reason: Detail describes the countertop. Carried in Division 06 with the casework; MasterFormat lists countertops at 12 36 00. Judgment call recorded as an assumption.
candidates.notes: Move to Division 12 if the cost code list separates countertops from casework.

candidates.candidate: Undermount sink at Break Room 312 countertop with rough-in
candidates.quote: UNDERMOUNT SINK BY PLUMBING CONTRACTOR, SEE P-101.
candidates.reason: A-501 points to P-101 for the sink and rough-in. P-101 is a scanned sheet and was unreadable after OCR, so the fixture, waste, vent, and water connections are not confirmed.

candidates.candidate: Undercounter refrigerator and countertop microwave in Break Room 312
candidates.quote: APPLIANCES ARE OWNER FURNISHED, OWNER INSTALLED (OFOI).
candidates.reason: Detail note assigns the appliances to the owner. The casework openings sized for them are part of cand-009.

candidates.candidate: Ceiling exhaust fan EF-1 in Break Room 312, approximately 75 CFM, ducted to the existing shaft
candidates.quote: EF-1 CEILING EXHAUST FAN, 75 CFM (APPROX), BREAK ROOM 312, DUCT TO EXISTING SHAFT, VIF
candidates.reason: Equipment schedule row defines the fan and its duct route. Shaft connection is marked verify in field. Test and balance from mechanical note 2 is carried with this item and recorded as an assumption.
candidates.notes: Includes the test and balance report required by M-101 mechanical note 2.

candidates.candidate: Thermostats and DDC connections for the mechanical work in Suite 300, including EF-1
candidates.quote: THERMOSTATS AND DDC CONNECTIONS BY BASE BUILDING CONTROLS CONTRACTOR UNDER SEPARATE CONTRACT WITH LANDLORD.
candidates.reason: Mechanical note assigns controls to the landlord's controls contractor under a separate contract.

candidates.candidate: Lighting fixture type L1, 2x4 LED troffer, 4000K, 0-10V dimming, lay-in, in Open Office 301 and Offices 305 through 309
candidates.quote: L1 2X4 LED TROFFER, 4000K, 0-10V DIMMING, LAY-IN, OPEN OFFICE 301, OFFICES 305-309
candidates.reason: Fixture schedule row defines the fixture and rooms.

candidates.candidate: Ceiling-mounted occupancy sensors in all enclosed rooms, controlling lighting and the receptacle circuits indicated on E-101
candidates.quote: PROVIDE CEILING-MOUNTED OCCUPANCY SENSORS IN ALL ENCLOSED ROOMS PER ENERGY CODE. SENSORS TO CONTROL BOTH LIGHTING AND RECEPTACLE CIRCUITS WHERE INDICATED ON E-101.
candidates.reason: Lighting note describes the sensors. Lighting controls stay in Division 26; no Division 25 or 27 sheet claims them.

candidates.candidate: Fire sprinkler head relocation and additions to suit the new ceiling layout, design-build under deferred submittal
candidates.quote: FIRE SPRINKLER HEAD RELOCATION AND ADDITIONS TO SUIT THE NEW CEILING LAYOUT ARE DESIGN-BUILD BY THE FIRE PROTECTION CONTRACTOR UNDER DEFERRED SUBMITTAL.
candidates.reason: General note assigns the work to the fire protection contractor as design-build within the contract; it is not marked by others or NIC. No fire protection sheet is in the set.

candidates.candidate: Doors, frames, and hardware per the door schedule
candidates.quote: DOORS, FRAMES, AND HARDWARE PER DOOR SCHEDULE, SHEET A-601.
candidates.reason: G-001 points to A-601 for the door schedule. A-601 extraction returned only the title block, so no door, frame, or hardware rows were read. Re-extract A-601 with OCR before recording door candidates.

candidates.candidate: New lay-in acoustical ceiling grid and tile in Open Office 301 and Offices 305 through 309 to receive type L1 troffers
candidates.location: Lighting fixture schedule, type L1, mounting column
candidates.quote: L1 ... LAY-IN ... OPEN OFFICE 301, OFFICES 305-309
candidates.reason: Inference: A-101 note 3 removes the existing grid in these rooms and E-201 schedules lay-in fixtures there, so a new lay-in ceiling is needed, but A-103 extracted text shows only room tags and ceiling heights and no ceiling type or legend surfaced. Confirm the ceiling type on A-103 before including.

assumptions.text: The solid surface countertop is carried in Division 06 with the casework rather than Division 12.
Test and balance for EF-1 is carried with the Division 23 work rather than as a separate item.
Slab leveling with a stated flatness tolerance applies to Break Room 312 only; other rooms get slab preparation after carpet removal without a stated tolerance.
assumptions.source: A-201, finish note 2; A-101, keyed note 2

exclusions.text: Furniture, systems furniture, and tenant equipment are NIC, furnished and installed by the tenant.
Existing Corridor 300 finishes are not in contract; the corridor ceiling remains and is protected.
exclusions.source: A-201, finish note 1; A-101, keyed note 3

rfis.text: P-101 is a scanned image and unreadable after OCR. Request a native PDF so the sink, rough-in, waste, vent, and any other plumbing fixtures can be recorded.
A-601 text extraction returned only the title block. Request the door schedule as a native PDF or OCR the sheet before recording door, frame, and hardware scope.
A-103 shows room tags and ceiling heights but no ceiling type in the extracted text. Confirm the ceiling type and grid for Open Office 301 and Offices 305 through 309.
rfis.source: A-103; A-101, keyed note 3; E-201, type L1

rfis.text: EF-1 is ducted to an existing shaft marked verify in field. Confirm the shaft is available and whether a fire or smoke damper is required at the shaft connection; no damper is shown.

New partitions on A-102 are shown as plan callouts without a partition type legend in the extracted text. Confirm partition types, heights, and any rated assemblies so Division 07 firestopping and Division 09 partitions can be recorded.
rfis.source: A-102; not stated in the extracted text

rfis.text: A-201 finish schedule lists floor finishes only; no paint or wall finish code appears in the extracted text. Confirm wall finishes for new and existing gypsum board.
rfis.source: A-201; not stated in the extracted text
